{{short description|None}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2024}}
[[File:Ronaldo in 2018.jpg|thumb|[[Cristiano Ronaldo]] made 183 [[UEFA Champions League]] appearances, the most in the competition.]]
Since the rebranding of the [[UEFA Champions League|European Champion Clubs' Cup]] to [[UEFA Champions League]] in 1992 at the start of the [[1992–93 UEFA Champions League|1992–93 season]], a total of 57 players have managed to make at least 100 appearances in the competition.<ref name="100Games" /> The first player to hit the landmark was [[Raúl (footballer)|Raúl]], who did so in February 2006,<ref>{{cite news |date=22 February 2006 |title=Defeat mars Raúl record |publisher=[[UEFA]] |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/01b2-0e9f72adcb96-1eeec3fee131-1000--defeat-mars-raul-record/ |access-date=4 April 2018}}</ref> while the most recent member of the "100 club" is [[Kylian Mbappé]], who played his 100th match on 14 October 2026.<ref name="100Games"/> [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] has made the most appearances in the Champions League, playing 183 matches.<ref>{{cite news |date=29 September 2021 |title=Cristiano Ronaldo sets new Champions League appearance record |work=[[UEFA]] |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/026d-133df01d539d-bb2f237fb666-1000--ronaldo-sets-appearance-record/ |access-date=29 September 2021}}</ref>

Eight players scored in their 100th appearance: [[Thierry Henry]] (for [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] against [[Sporting CP]]) on 26 November 2008, [[Zlatan Ibrahimović]] (for [[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] against [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]]) on 27 November 2013, Cristiano Ronaldo (for [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] against [[Borussia Dortmund]]) on 2 April 2014, [[Andrea Pirlo]] (for [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] against Olympiacos) on 4 November 2014, [[Toni Kroos]] (for Real Madrid against [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]]) on 22 October 2019, [[Robert Lewandowski]] (for [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] against [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]]) on 2 November 2021, [[Antoine Griezmann]] (for [[Atlético Madrid]] against [[AC Sparta Prague|Sparta Prague]]) on 26 November 2024 and Mbappé (for [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] against [[AS Roma|AS Roma]]) on 14 October 2026.<ref>{{cite tweet |number=1186726964503158784 |user=ChampionsLeague |author=UEFA Champions League |author-link=UEFA Champions League |title=Players to score on their 100th #UCL appearance |date=22 October 2019}}</ref>

Of the players who have reached this landmark, only nine have never won the Champions League ([[Gianluigi Buffon]], Ibrahimović, [[Cesc Fàbregas]], [[Fernandinho (footballer, born May 1985)|Fernandinho]], Griezmann, [[Koke (footballer, born 1992)|Koke]],  [[Jan Oblak]], Otamendi and Mbappé), with Buffon (as well as former Juventus teammate [[Paolo Montero]]) having reached three finals without winning.<ref>{{cite news |date=7 February 2018 |title=Who has played most games without winning the Champions League? |work=[[UEFA]] |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0242-0e984f6a1600-75a3228a1f4b-1000--who-has-played-most-games-without-winning-the-champions-league/ |access-date=24 April 2020}}</ref>
